title: Are You Actually Enjoying Your Life?
fullTitle: Soul Snack #78: Are You Actually Enjoying Your Life?

promo.text: Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen Here

description: Linda Francis reveals a powerful internal indicator: when you are not truly enjoying yourself, a frightened part of your personality is in command.
The moment you notice this lack of joy is the very moment you are being invited to choose again.
The path is available in every moment: choose the loving part of your personality – the part that always enjoys itself – and create Authentic Power by letting it lead.

Pause and reflect: how much of your day are you truly enjoying yourself? The next time you notice tension, frustration, or a quiet sense of dread, stop and ask yourself – is a frightened part of my personality running the show right now? You don’t need to judge it. Simply notice it. Then ask: what would it feel like to choose the loving part of my personality instead? Try it once today – just once – and notice what shifts.
